title: An exact repeat is answered from the cache
goal: For {{castBrand}}, {{castApp}} asks the same question again and again while {{castTask}}, and each ask costs a model call.
obstacle: Without a cache every repeat goes to the model, and the Usage view would show a request each time and nothing saved.
control: The key's cache answers the repeat itself: the score is 1, the model is not called, and Usage shows From cache and Saved (the lab counts the stored answer's output tokens).
